persistent_index_state.caution: Raw source evidence is now complete and readable. The committed compact indexes still reflect the prior full 1,090-record build; run the deterministic builder on a checkout before claiming a newly regenerated index byte-for-byte.

retrieval_policy.lexical: Deterministic BM25 over a fully materialized normalized corpus. Partial builds are forbidden.
retrieval_policy.dense: Vector embeddings are downstream/model-specific and intentionally not committed as canonical repository state.
retrieval_policy.hybrid: Use lexical retrieval for deterministic baseline/routing, then optional dense reranking or embedding retrieval over the same fully materialized documents.
retrieval_policy.provenance: Every normalized document must retain source_record_index, raw shard, record type, FormID, source offset, and speaker attribution when available.
retrieval_policy.book_provenance: Use book-source-relations.json to route reused BOOK records to central source/work witnesses while preserving Wheels-local variants.

storage_policy: Normalized full-text retrieval documents are regenerated from canonical raw shards to avoid duplicating source text in Git. Compact deterministic indexes may be committed because they are cheap to verify and useful for routing.
current_rebuild_requirements: Run build-retrieval-index.py over all 1,090 core source records on a checkout.
Validate generated routing and lexical artifacts against the expected 1,090-document count before replacing persistent indexes.
Keep the 370-record implementation-evidence layer separate unless secondary retrieval is explicitly enabled.
